title: 债市看穿美联储承诺：通胀风险溢价上升，纳税人将承担代价？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Mark a banner of Bank of America looking forward, writing the Fed now has a credibility issue to deal with.
segments.zh: 美国银行分析师马克·卡巴纳表示，美联储现在面临信誉问题。

segments.en: We believe they will want to regain control of the narrative. Mark trying to snuff from all. Mark, good morning.
segments.zh: 我们认为他们会希望重新掌控叙事。马克，早上好。

segments.en: Morning. Are you upset that Daddy Fed's not longer provided guidance, too? No, I'm not upset about that. I just want to understand what the reaction function is, and I want to understand what is the justification for any decision that they make.
segments.zh: 早上好。你对美联储不再提供前瞻指引感到不满吗？不，我并不为此不满。我只是想了解他们的反应机制，以及他们做出任何决定的理由。

segments.en: It's fine that you don't have to tell us exactly what you're going to do, but the analogy that we were discussing earlier is if I tell you that I'm going to lose weight, and I'm going to lose 15 pounds, then you're going to want to know how I plan to do that.
segments.zh: 你不必告诉我们具体要做什么，但打个比方，如果我说我要减肥15磅，你会想知道我打算怎么做。

segments.en: And if I tell you that I'm not going to do it through diet exercise or GLP1, then you're going to have to question how committed am I to actually doing this.
segments.zh: 如果我说不是通过节食、运动或药物，那你就会质疑我是否真的下定决心。

segments.en: And that is exactly what the market is doing right now for the Fed.
segments.zh: 这正是市场目前对美联储的看法。

segments.en: It's wonderful that you're resolute in your determination to have 2% inflation, just like I'm resolute to lose weight. But unless I tell you how I'm going to do it,
segments.zh: 你决心实现2%的通胀目标，这很好，就像我决心减肥一样。但除非你告诉我如何实现，

segments.en: we will not believe you. And you can't fool the bond. You can't do it.
segments.zh: 否则我们不会相信你。你无法欺骗债券市场，做不到。

segments.en: The bond will see through it, and that is our interpretation of what happened last week.
segments.zh: 债券市场会看穿一切，这就是我们对上周情况的解读。

segments.en: And if this continues, the bond will continue to reflect a greater inflation risk premium and more uncertainty. And the only one who's going to be crying will be the taxpayer,
segments.zh: 如果这种情况持续，债券市场将继续反映更高的通胀风险溢价和更多不确定性。最终受害的将是纳税人。

segments.en: because it means higher associated costs and likely wider bid offer spreads.
segments.zh: 因为这意味着更高的相关成本，以及可能更宽的买卖价差。

segments.en: So it's really a choice for the Fed. We're not crying because we need the forward guidance.
segments.zh: 所以这确实是美联储的选择。我们并非因为需要前瞻指引而抱怨。
